_doc: Mission file (openspec/changes/mission-scripting; the format is docs/design/mission-files.md). Edit with tools/mission-editor or by hand.
name: Capture a ship
objective: Board and take the ship. Needs marines.
brief: The {group} is alone here. Drop its shields, beat it down until it strikes, and board it.

objectives.text: Take it with more than a sixth of its hull

result.log: The {group} is ours, and joins the fleet.
